blocks.text: Pichle sabaq (11.5) mein humne seekha ke \(a + b\sin(c\theta + d)\) jaise function ka maximum \(a + |b|\) aur minimum \(a - |b|\) hota hai, aur period \(\frac{2\pi}{c}\). Ab yahi formulas asal zindagi mein istemal karenge: jhoole (Ferris wheel) par baithe shakhs ki unchai, darya mein paani ki satah ka utaar charhaao, aur jheel mein pahaar ke aks (reflection) se pahaar ki unchai. Achhi baat yeh hai ke har sawal ek hi tareeqe se hal hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har application wale sawal ka plan:
1. Sawal se sab se bari value \(M\), sab se chhoti value \(m\), aur ek poore chakkar (cycle) ka waqt nikaalein.
2. Amplitude \(b = \frac{M - m}{2}\), midline \(a = \frac{M + m}{2}\), aur period \(= \frac{2\pi}{c}\) se \(c\) nikaalein.
3. Dekhein harkat kahan se shuru hoti hai (upar se, neeche se, ya beech se), aur us hisaab se sine ya cosine chunein.
4. Diya hua waqt rakh kar hisaab karein, aur jawab ko \(m\) aur \(M\) ke darmiyan hone se check karein.

Pehla Ferris wheel (bara gol jhoola, jaisa melon aur theme parks mein hota hai) George W. Ferris ne banaya tha, 1893 ke World's Fair ke liye. Ferris wheel periodic motion (baar baar dohraane wali harkat) ki behtareen misaal hai: har chakkar ke baad sawaar wapas usi unchai par aa jata hai. Is liye sawaar ki unchai ko waqt ke saath sinusoidal function se bayan kiya ja sakta hai. Ferris wheel ki harkat ka model yeh ho sakta hai:
\[f(t) = a + b\sin(ct + d)\]
ya
\[f(t) = a + b\cos(ct + d)\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Socho aap jhoole mein sab se neeche wali seat par baithe hain. Jhoola ghoomta hai: aap upar jate hain, sab se upar pohanchte hain, phir neeche aate hain, aur ek chakkar ke baad wapas sab se neeche. Agar har second aap ki unchai note karein aur graph banayein to bilkul sine/cosine jaisi lehar banegi. Yahi wajah hai ke trigonometry yahan kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem: A Ferris wheel with a radius of 45 feet has its lowest point located 5 feet above the ground. It completes one full revolution every 60 seconds in the counter-clockwise direction. Model an equation that describes the height of a rider on the Ferris wheel as a function of time \(t\). How high is the rider from the ground after 40 seconds? Also graph the model equation.
steps:
Given: radius 45 ft, sab se neeche wala nuqta zameen se 5 ft upar, ek poora chakkar 60 second mein, sawaar sab se neeche se shuru karta hai.
To find: unchai ka model \(h(t)\), 40 second baad unchai, aur graph.
Method: sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke humein teen numbers chahiye: \(c\) (period se), \(b\) (amplitude, jo radius hai), aur \(a\) (centre ki unchai). Phir dekhenge ke sawaar neeche se shuru karta hai, is liye negative cosine lagega.

Step 1: Period se \(c\) nikaalein
Ek poora chakkar (ek cycle) 60 second mein, yani period \(= 60\).
\[\dfrac{2\pi}{c} = 60\]
\[c = \dfrac{2\pi}{60} = \dfrac{\pi}{30}\]
Kyun: \(a + b\cos(ct)\) ka period \(\frac{2\pi}{c}\) hai, aur ek chakkar ke baad sawaar wapas usi unchai par hota hai. Is liye period wahi waqt hai jo ek chakkar mein lagta hai.

Step 2: Amplitude aur vertical shift
Amplitude \(b\) jhoole ke radius ke barabar hai: \(b = 45\).
Vertical shift \(a\) jhoole ke centre ki zameen se unchai hai. Sab se neeche wala nuqta 5 ft par hai aur centre us se radius jitna upar, is liye
\[a = 5 + b = 5 + 45 = 50\]
Kyun: sawaar centre se 45 ft upar aur 45 ft neeche tak jata hai, yani centre hi midline hai. 11.5 ke formulas se tasdeeq: sab se upar \(M = 5 + 90 = 95\), sab se neeche \(m = 5\); to \(a = \frac{95 + 5}{2} = 50\) aur \(b = \frac{95 - 5}{2} = 45\). Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab.

Step 3: Sine ya cosine?
Unchai ka model sine ya cosine dono se ban sakta hai, kyun ke dono harkat ki periodic nature dikhaate hain. Aam tor par agar sawaar sab se upar se shuru kare to cosine, aur agar beech (midline) se shuru kare to sine lete hain. Yahan sawaar sab se neeche se shuru kar ke upar jata hai, is liye negative cosine:
\[h(t) = -b\cos(ct) + a\]
jahan \(t\) waqt aur \(h\) unchai hai.
Kyun: \(\cos 0 = 1\), is liye \(-\cos(ct)\) waqt \(t = 0\) par apni sab se chhoti value \(-1\) par hota hai aur phir barhta hai, bilkul sawaar ki tarah jo neeche se upar jata hai.

Step 4: Model likhein
\[h(t) = -45\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{30}t\right) + 50\]
Yahi Ferris wheel ki required equation hai.
Kyun: \(b = 45\), \(c = \frac{\pi}{30}\), \(a = 50\) rakh diye.
Tasdeeq: \(h(0) = -45 + 50 = 5\) (sab se neeche, sahi) aur \(h(30) = -45\cos\pi + 50 = 45 + 50 = 95\) (aadhe chakkar baad sab se upar, sahi).

Step 5: 40 second baad unchai
\[h(40) = -45\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi}{30} \cdot 40\right) + 50\]
\[= -45\cos\dfrac{4\pi}{3} + 50\]
\[= -45\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right) + 50\]
\[= 22.5 + 50 = 72.5\]
Kyun: \(\frac{4\pi}{3} = 240^{\circ}\) hai, jo Quadrant III mein hai jahan cosine negative hota hai, aur \(\cos 240^{\circ} = -\cos 60^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\). Do minus mil kar plus ban gaye.
Dhyan dein: calculator degree mode mein ho aur aap \(\cos(4.19)\) degree mein le lein to jawab ghalat aayega. Angle radians mein hai.

Step 6: Model ka graph
\(0 \le t \le 60\) ke liye \(h(t)\) banayein: graph \((0, 5)\) se shuru hota hai, \(t = 15\) par midline \(h = 50\) cross karta hai, \((30, 95)\) par sab se upar, \(t = 45\) par phir midline, aur \((60, 5)\) par wapas neeche. Point \((40, 72.5)\) bhi nishaan zada hai (figure dekhiye).
Kyun: yeh paanch points (shuru, midline, choti, midline, aakhir) ek doosre se chauthai period (15 second) ke faasle par hain, aur inhi se poori lehar ki shakal tay ho jati hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(72.5\) sab se kam unchai 5 aur sab se zyada 95 ke darmiyan hai. 40 second par sawaar choti (30 second) se guzar kar neeche aa raha hai, is liye unchai 50 aur 95 ke darmiyan honi chahiye. Jawab bilkul theek baithta hai.
blocks.answer: Model: \(h(t) = -45\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{30}t\right) + 50\). 40 second baad sawaar zameen se 72.5 feet upar hai.

Right: grid graph of h(t) = minus 45 cos(pi t over 30) + 50: 5 at t = 0, 95 at t = 30, 5 at t = 60, with a bar b = 45 at t = 30 and the point at t = 40 marked 72.5 ft.

blocks.title: Teaching note
Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar isi jhoole par sawaar sab se upar se shuru kare to model kya hoga, aur 40 second baad unchai kitni hogi?
(Jawab: \(h(t) = 45\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{30}t\right) + 50\), aur \(h(40) = 45\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) + 50 = 27.5\) ft.)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Graph se kya seekhte hain? Graph dekh kar har sawal ka jawab andaze se bhi mil jata hai. Misal ke tor par: sawaar kab midline (50 ft) par hota hai? Graph \(h = 50\) ko \(t = 15\) aur \(t = 45\) par kaatti hai, yani chauthai aur teen chauthai chakkar par. Aur sawaar kitni der 72.5 ft se upar rehta hai? Graph dekhiye: 72.5 wali line choti ke dono taraf graph ko kaat'ti hai, \(t = 20\) aur \(t = 40\) par, to 20 second tak. Is tarah ka andaza exam mein apne jawab ko jaanchne ke liye bohat kaam aata hai.
Ek aur baat: kitab kehti hai jhoola counter-clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ke ulat) ghoomta hai. Unchai ke liye is se farq nahin parta; clockwise ghoomne par bhi sawaar neeche se upar hi jata hai, is liye model wahi rehta hai.
Ab ek aur misaal dekhte hain. Is baar model kitab ne khud de diya hai; humein sirf use samajh kar istemal karna hai.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.problem:
The water level \(L\) in feet of a tidal river varies throughout the day. Suppose the level of the tidal river can be modelled by the equation \(L(t) = 8 + 4\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t\right)\), where \(t\) denotes the time in hours. The water level oscillates 4 feet above and below an average level of 8 feet.
(a) Find the water level at \(t = 3\) hours.
(b) What is the minimum water level?
steps:
Given: \(L(t) = 8 + 4\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t\right)\), \(t\) ghanton (hours) mein.
To find: (a) \(L(3)\); (b) \(L(t)\) ki sab se kam value.
Method: (a) mein sirf \(t = 3\) rakhna hai. (b) mein \(a + b\sin(\ldots)\) ka minimum chahiye; \(b = 4\) positive hai, is liye minimum tab jab sine \(-1\) ho, yani \(m = a - |b|\). Tidal river (aisa darya jis ka paani samundar ke jowar bhaata ke saath charhta utarta hai) ka paani 8 ft ki average satah se 4 ft upar aur 4 ft neeche jata hai.

Step 1: (a) \(t = 3\) rakhein
\[L(3) = 8 + 4\sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6} \cdot 3\right)\]
\[= 8 + 4\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: model har waqt ki satah batata hai; humein sirf \(t\) ki jagah 3 likhna hai. \(\frac{\pi}{6} \times 3 = \frac{3\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{2}\).

Step 2: (a) hal karein
\[L(3) = 8 + 4(1) = 12\]
Kyun: \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = \sin 90^{\circ} = 1\).
Yani 3 ghante baad paani ki satah 12 feet hai. Ghor karein: yeh asal mein sab se oonchi satah \(8 + 4\) hai.

Step 3: (b) satah sab se kam kab?
Sab se kam satah ke liye sine ki sab se kam value chahiye, jo \(-1\) hai. \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t\right) = -1\) rakhein:
\[L(t) = 8 + 4(-1)\]
\[= 8 - 4 = 4\]
Kyun: \(b = 4\) positive hai, is liye jab sine sab se chhota ho to \(L\) bhi sab se chhota. Formula se bhi: \(m = a - |b| = 8 - 4 = 4\).

Tasdeeq:
Sine \(-1\) tab hota hai jab \(\frac{\pi}{6}t = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), yani \(t = 9\) ghante: \(L(9) = 8 + 4\sin\frac{3\pi}{2} = 8 - 4 = 4\). Aur sawal mein likha hai ke paani 8 ft se 4 ft upar neeche jata hai, yani 4 se 12 tak. Dono jawab isi range mein hain.
blocks.answer: (a) 3 ghante par paani ki satah 12 feet hai. (b) Sab se kam satah 4 feet hai (pehli dafa \(t = 9\) ghante par).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Example 4 ka period \(\frac{2\pi}{\pi/6} = 12\) ghante hai: darya har 12 ghante mein ek dafa charhta aur utarta hai. Asal samundari jowar bhaata (tides) bhi din mein taqreeban do dafa aata hai, is liye yeh model haqeeqat ke qareeb hai.
Machhera ya kashti chalane wala aise model se pehle hi jaan sakta hai ke paani kab sab se kam hoga (yahan \(t = 9\) aur \(t = 21\) ghante par), taa ke kashti us waqt kinare par na phanse. Yahi trigonometry ka asal faida hai: aane wale waqt ka andaza.
Aakhri misaal thori mukhtalif hai: yahan koi lehar nahin, balke angles of elevation aur depression (upar aur neeche dekhne ke zaviye) aur tan ratio istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.problem: From a point 100 m above the surface of a lake, the angle of elevation of a peak of a cliff is found to be \(15^{\circ}\) and the angle of depression of the image of the peak is \(30^{\circ}\). Find the height of the peak.
steps:
Given: dekhne wala \(P\) jheel se 100 m upar hai; pahaar ki choti ka angle of elevation \(15^{\circ}\); paani mein us ke aks (image) ka angle of depression \(30^{\circ}\).
To find: pahaar ki jheel se unchai \(h\).
Method: sab se pehle yeh samajhna zaroori hai ke saakin paani aaine ki tarah kaam karta hai: aks paani ki satah se utna hi neeche nazar aata hai jitni choti upar hai. Phir do right triangles banenge jin ki horizontal side \(PQ\) ek hi hai; dono se tan ki equations likh kar divide karenge, to anjaana faasla khatam ho jayega.

Step 1: Points ke naam (figure dekhiye)
\(A\) pahaar \(\overline{AM}\) ki choti hai aur \(\overline{MB}\) us ka aks. \(P\) dekhne ka nuqta hai aur \(L\) jheel ki satah par \(P\) ke bilkul neeche wala nuqta. \(P\) se \(\overline{PQ} \perp \overline{AM}\) kheenchein.
Maan lein \(m\overline{PQ} = y\) metre aur \(m\overline{AM} = h\) metre.
Kyun: aaine wale qaide se \(m\overline{MB} = h\) bhi hai. Naam rakhne se har lambai ko alag likhna aasan ho jata hai.

Step 2: \(AQ\) aur \(BQ\) ki lambai
\[m\overline{AQ} = h - m\overline{QM}\]
\[= h - m\overline{PL} = h - 100\]
\[m\overline{BQ} = m\overline{QM} + m\overline{MB}\]
\[= 100 + h\]
Kyun: \(PQ\) horizontal aur \(PL\) vertical hai, is liye \(QM\) bhi \(PL\) jitna, yani 100 m. \(Q\) paani se 100 m upar hai, is liye choti tak \(h - 100\) bachta hai aur aks tak \(100 + h\).

Step 3: Tan ki do equations
\[\tan 15^{\circ} = \dfrac{AQ}{PQ} = \dfrac{h - 100}{y}\]
\[\tan 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{BQ}{PQ} = \dfrac{100 + h}{y}\]
Kyun: right triangles \(PQA\) aur \(PQB\) mein tan = saamne wali side / saath wali side, aur dono ki saath wali side \(PQ = y\) hai.

Step 4: Divide kar ke \(y\) khatam karein
\[\dfrac{\tan 15^{\circ}}{\tan 30^{\circ}} = \dfrac{h - 100}{h + 100}\]
Kyun: \(y\) humein maloom nahin aur poocha bhi nahin gaya. Dono equations ko divide karne se \(y\) cancel ho jata hai aur sirf \(h\) bachta hai.

Step 5: Componendo aur dividendo
\[\dfrac{\tan 15^{\circ} + \tan 30^{\circ}}{\tan 15^{\circ} - \tan 30^{\circ}}\]
\[= \dfrac{(h - 100) + (h + 100)}{(h - 100) - (h + 100)}\]
\[= \dfrac{2h}{-200} = \dfrac{h}{-100}\]
Kyun: componendo aur dividendo ka qaida: agar \(\frac{p}{q} = \frac{r}{s}\) ho to \(\frac{p + q}{p - q} = \frac{r + s}{r - s}\). Yahan yeh is liye chuna kyun ke jama karne par 100 cancel ho jate hain aur tafreeq par \(h\) cancel; nateeja ek seedhi si equation hai jis mein \(h\) akela hai.

Step 6: \(h\) nikaalein
\[h = \dfrac{\tan 30^{\circ} + \tan 15^{\circ}}{\tan 30^{\circ} - \tan 15^{\circ}} \times 100\]
\[= \dfrac{0.5774 + 0.2679}{0.5774 - 0.2679} \times 100\]
\[h = 273.1179\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(-100\) se multiply kiya; minus sign denominator ki tarteeb ulat kar khatam ho gaya (\(\tan 15^{\circ} - \tan 30^{\circ}\) ki jagah \(\tan 30^{\circ} - \tan 15^{\circ}\)). Tan ki values chaar decimal tak li gayi hain.

Tasdeeq:
Exact value: \(\dfrac{\tan 30^{\circ} + \tan 15^{\circ}}{\tan 30^{\circ} - \tan 15^{\circ}} = \dfrac{\sin 45^{\circ}}{\sin 15^{\circ}} = \sqrt{3} + 1\), is liye \(h = 100(\sqrt{3} + 1) \approx 273.2\) m.
Phir \(y = \frac{100 + h}{\tan 30^{\circ}} \approx 646.4\) m, aur \(\frac{h - 100}{y} \approx \frac{173.2}{646.4} \approx 0.2679 = \tan 15^{\circ}\). Dono equations poori utarti hain.
blocks.answer: Pahaar ki unchai taqreeban 273 m hai (exact \(100(\sqrt{3} + 1) \approx 273.2\) m).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab ka \(h = 273.1179\) is liye aaya ke \(\tan 30^{\circ}\) aur \(\tan 15^{\circ}\) chaar decimal tak round kiye gaye. Exact values se \(h = 100(\sqrt{3} + 1) = 273.205\ldots\) m banta hai. Dono ka round off kitab ke final jawab 273 m ke barabar hai, is liye jawab sahi hai; bas aakhri decimals mein thora farq hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin: ek jhoole ka radius 20 m hai, sab se neeche wala nuqta zameen se 2 m upar hai, aur ek chakkar 40 second mein poora hota hai. Sawaar neeche se shuru karta hai.
\(b = 20\), \(a = 2 + 20 = 22\), \(\frac{2\pi}{c} = 40 \Rightarrow c = \frac{\pi}{20}\).
Model: \(h(t) = -20\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{20}t\right) + 22\).
10 second baad: \(h(10) = -20\cos\frac{\pi}{2} + 22 = 0 + 22 = 22\) m, yani chauthai chakkar baad sawaar centre ki unchai par hai. Bilkul mantiqi!

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Data se model: amplitude \(b = \frac{M - m}{2}\), midline \(a = \frac{M + m}{2}\), period \(= \frac{2\pi}{c}\).
2. Ferris wheel: amplitude = radius, midline = centre ki unchai, period = ek chakkar ka waqt.
3. Neeche se shuru: \(h = a - b\cos(ct)\); upar se: \(a + b\cos(ct)\); beech se upar jate hue: \(a + b\sin(ct)\).
4. Har model ko \(t = 0\) aur aadhe period par check karein.
5. Aks (reflection) wale sawal: aks paani se utna hi neeche jitni cheez upar hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Amplitude mein diameter (90) le lena; sahi radius (45) hai.
2. Vertical shift 5 (sab se neeche wala nuqta) le lena; sahi centre ki unchai (50) hai.
3. Neeche se shuru hone wale sawaar ke liye \(+45\cos\) likhna: is se \(h(0) = 95\) aata hai, jo choti hai.
4. \(\frac{\pi}{30} \cdot 40\) ko calculator ke degree mode mein hal karna: angle radians mein hai (\(\frac{4\pi}{3} = 240^{\circ}\)).
5. Example 5 mein \(BQ = h\) le lena; sahi \(100 + h\) hai, kyun ke \(Q\) paani se 100 m upar hai.
